sample_unit: simulated chatbot sessions with artificial users
unlisted_practices: Expert clinician rating of LLM chatbot sessions with LLM-simulated artificial users derived from clinical vignettes to evaluate delivery of a structured behavioral activation intervention

screen.reason: The study evaluated a newly developed GPT-4o-based behavioral activation chatbot using simulated interactions with artificial (LLM-simulated) users and expert psychotherapist ratings, without evaluating a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail comparison.
